description: This file contains a React component implementing the login page of a Next.js application. It includes UI elements like input fields for email and password, role switch, buttons for social login, and visual art components. It also handles setting an authentication cookie and navigation upon login.

methods.name: clampNextPath
methods.description: Ensures the 'next' path parameter is safe and valid for redirection.

methods.name: setAuthCookie
methods.description: Sets a client-side cookie with the user's role and email, including a timestamp.
